name: project-brain
description: Git-native project memory, UI/Backend quality enforcement, task complexity scoring, CLI agent discovery, quota management, and sub-agent delegation.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, delegate, verify, review, and resume projects with quota-aware CLI workers
interface.longDescription: Project Brain 3.5.1 keeps plans, architecture and verification evidence in Git. Its dependency-free Python runtime supports upfront session EXEC/REV mode selection (Pool, Self/Native, Solo) for unattended execution and review, smart takeover/digest deduplication, owner model pools, fixed effort, quota reserves and write recovery. Artifact and test evidence are required before claiming task completion.
defaultPrompt: Set up Project Brain for this repository
Continue where the last session stopped
Scan CLI agents and delegate ready tasks
